image.note: LoadImage expects a filename inside the ComfyUI input folder (upload first). The model/character photo: the loader placed on its own above the row of clothing loaders; second image in the ReferenceLatent chain (5 -> 17 -> 34 -> 35).

clothes.note: LoadImage expects a filename inside the ComfyUI input folder (upload first). First clothing reference (first ReferenceLatent 5). Extra clothing slots: LoadImage 27 (third) and LoadImage 26 (fourth); leave them or fill with more pieces.

prompt.note: Default 'place the pieces of clothing, hat and glasses on the model'.

image.note: No SaveImage in this workflow; node 4 previews the decoded result (temp/). Runner fetches via /view?type=temp or a human swaps in SaveImage.

notes: The loaders carry no titles; the model-vs-clothes assignment is inferred from canvas layout and filenames (15 = generated character shot). Verify once on the pod.
Negative is ConditioningZeroOut 2 (no text). All four references are resized to 1024 by ImageResizeKJv2 24/25/28/29.
